pledges.remindBody: They will receive a polite message with their balance and a link to pay.
pledges.reminded: {count, plural, one {# reminder sent} other {# reminders sent}}
pledges.policy: Require a pledge before the card
pledges.policyHelp: When on, a card is issued only after the guest makes a pledge. This can upset guests and reduce attendance — use with care.
pledges.policyOnBody: Guests without a pledge will not be able to see their card until they make one. You can turn it off at any time.
